## add-entity

Spawn a new entity from an archetype or bundle.

`changesState` `persistsWorld`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archetypeOrDef` | `object` | yes | Archetype name string or inline entity definition. |
| `overrides` | `object` | no | Component overrides to apply after spawning. |

## delete-entity

Delete an entity by its stable ID.

`changesState` `persistsWorld`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stableId` | `number` | yes | Stable ID of the entity to delete. |

## duplicate-entity

Duplicate an entity with an optional offset.

`changesState` `persistsWorld`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stableId` | `number` | yes | Stable ID of the entity to duplicate. |
| `offset` | `object` | no | Optional offset { x, y, z } applied to the duplicate. |

## run-world-script

Execute a trusted JavaScript world script and replace the current world.

`changesState` `persistsWorld`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` | no | Inline JavaScript/MJS world script source. Requires explicit world-script permission. |

| `validate` | `boolean` | no | When true, include a scene-evaluation report after the script runs. |

## upsert-module-type

Register or replace a persisted runtime module type backed by factory source.

`changesState` `persistsWorld`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `moduleName` | `string` | yes | Target module name (for example "field" or "material"). |
| `typeName` | `string` | yes | Registered type name within the target module. |
| `factorySource` | `string` | yes | JavaScript source that evaluates to a factory function `(params, helpers) => resolvedValue`. |
| `description` | `string` | no | Optional human-readable description of the custom type. |
| `parameterSchema` | `object` | no | Optional JSON-schema-like description of the expected params payload. |

`changesState`
